passages.text: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.
passages.note: Peer pressure; standing apart from the crowd for what's right

passages.text: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again. If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him, you shall surely help him with it.
passages.note: Kindness toward someone who dislikes you; enmity

passages.text: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
passages.note: Integrity; temptation of personal gain clouding judgment

passages.text: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
passages.note: Empathy for outsiders from remembering your own hardship
